How to Change Your Discord Profile Banner

On Desktop

  1. Open Discord and go to User Settings by clicking the gear icon near your name.
  2. Select the Profiles tab in the left sidebar.
  3. Scroll down to the Profile Banner section.
  4. Click Upload Banner and select your downloaded banner from Pfps.gg.
  5. Adjust the positioning if needed and click Save Changes.

On Mobile

  1. Open the Discord app and tap your profile picture in the bottom bar.
  2. Tap Edit Profile.
  3. Tap on the current banner (or the placeholder) to upload a new one from your phone.
  4. Select your banner and confirm to update it.

You are all set! Your new Discord Banner from Pfps.gg is now live for everyone to see.
